instruction: A candid documentary wide shot captures an indoor training studio with a red carpet and white walls. On the left, the man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing right, executing a low kick with his right leg. On the right, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands with her back to the camera, observing his movement. The man's (R1) leg is extended forward and low towards her. The scene is brightly illuminated by overhead fluorescent lights, creating a neutral color palette with soft shadows on the red carpet.
